title: Bombay To Goa
desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman, a martial arts teacher, gains superpowers during a fight with Raka. But Raka becomes stronger after toxic exposure, and Aman must defeat him to save others.

title: Kesari
desc: Havildar Ishar Singh leads 21 brave Sikh soldiers against 10,000 Pashtun invaders, creating one of history's greatest last stands of courage and sacrifice.

title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.

title: Article 15
desc: Senior police officer Ayaan Ranjan has to come to grips with the reality of caste discrimination in the rural heartlands of India when a gruesome and unjust rape and murder case lands on his desk.

title: Om Jai Jagdish
desc: Three brothers put aside their differences to join forces and save their ancestral home from being auctioned, resolving their family's legacy and their own personal issues.

title: Tumsa Nahin Dekha: A Love Story
desc: A drunk millionaire falls for Jia, a street dancer, but risks losing his fortune if he refuses to marry Anahita, forcing him to choose between love and inheritance.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Narsimha
desc: A powerful divine being rises to stop a cruel ruler and protect a faithful child. The story highlights courage, justice, and the strength of true belief.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond
desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

title: Antim : The Final Truth
desc: A poor farmer's son rises in the city as a fearless gangster, but his reign is challenged when an unyielding cop steps in, sparking a fierce battle of power and justice.
